title: AFP welcomes United States' $5B arms sales, military financing to PH
summary: The Armed Forces of the Philippines on Friday welcomed continued support from the United States in strengthening its military capabilities following the approval of more than $5 billion in arms sales…

blocks.text: The Armed Forces of the Philippines on Friday welcomed continued support from the United States in strengthening its military capabilities following the approval of more than $5 billion in arms sales and increased military financing for the Philippines.
